fullContentHtml:
RRB ALP 01/2025 CBT-I Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the result for the Non Technical Popular Categories Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) post recruitment during the 12 April 2025, to 19 May 2025. There were 10,970 posts were called for the hiring of RRB ALP in various trades. The CBT examination was held from 13, 16, 17 & 18 February 2026 & 11 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can check their RRB ALP 01/2025 CBT-I Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 April 2025
  • Application Start Date : 12 April 2025
  • Last Date : 19 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 May 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 22-31 May 2025
  • Application Status : 05 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 13, 16, 17 & 18 February 2026
  • Exam City Details : 03 February 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 February 2026
  • Re Scheduled Exam Date : 11 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 06 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam
  • Answer Key Available On : 20 March 2026
  • Result Available : Soon

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 500/–
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam) :
  • General : Rs. 400/–
  • OBC / EWS / SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
